desc: THE CHURCHILL 620 TACTICAL 20GA 3″ PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN is purpose-built for home defense or as a police patrol shotgun. Outfitted with a standard stock and Picatinny receiver rail for optics or lights, extended tactical choke tube and ghost ring sight, the 18.5” shorter barreled shotgun is perfect for tight maneuvering. The polymer standard stock is are super durable no matter the conditions. Featuring a tactical breach tube. There is no need to get beat up with 12ga recoil today as there are many Tactical 20ga loads available.
